page0.text:
Once school ends, I quickly start to head home.
Since all after-school club activities are suspended, students crowd around the campus gate.
I take a cursory look around, and don't see anyone who might be Tohsaka.
Knowing her, she must have gone straight to the Matou house.

page1.text:
"Senpai? Are you trying to find someone?"
"Hm? Nah, I was just looking around. It's not every day you see this many students leaving at the same time."

page2.text:
"Yes. But thanks to that, we can go home together today. Should we do some shopping before we head back?"
"Yeah, let's pick up some stuff for dinner. Fuji-nee won't be coming over for a while, so we'll get enough for three: you, me, and Saber."

page3.text:
After we buy groceries, we take the long way home, passing by the park.
The park is empty.
There aren't any kids in the playground, nor a silver-haired girl in a coat.

page4.text: "...The park is empty. Do people not come here often?"

page5.text:
"Not lately, I think. When I was a kid, there would usually be someone here during the day, but these days it's pretty much like this except on days off."
"I see. It feels kind of lonely."

page6.text:
I nod in agreement and look up.
The sky is tinged twilight.
It's a dark red expanse with no birds in sight. It feels lonely, just like the small park.
